        DECISION GUIDE

        How to read the build

        Headroom
        Money left after the estimated component total.
        Peak draw
        Estimated maximum combined system power under sustained load.
        Upgrade room
        A composite score for power, memory, expansion, and case clearance.
        Cooler noise
        Estimated acoustic output of the selected CPU cooler.
        PSU reserve
        Power-supply capacity remaining above estimated peak draw.
        Value density
        Weighted component-tier points delivered per $1,000.
